Hi Ashley — great to meet you. Looping in Laura (Finance) and Rishi (PM) so we have the right owners on the thread. Below are our standard approaches and a short checklist to speed setup.

Short answers:
- Yes, ACH is our preferred method for recurring payments. We can accept a wire for the first payment if you prefer, but note wire fees are typically billed back to the vendor unless otherwise arranged.
- Please send remittance emails to remit@redwood.ai; include the invoice number and the PO number (if applicable) in the subject line.
- Redwood requires a PO for third-party services above the threshold of $5k. For smaller amounts we can accept invoices without a PO but payment timing may differ.

Action checklist (please return completed items):
- Signed Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (attached)
- Completed banking_details_template.csv with ACH & wire fields populated
- W9 (we have your attachment)
- Primary remit email and AP contact name/phone

Laura — can you confirm typical payment terms for vendor contracts (Net 30 vs Net 45) and whether we need a PO upfront for initial payment here?

Rishi — FYI this vendor will provide on-prem spare parts for our infra team; we might want to note delivery schedule in the SOW.

Thanks — I’ve attached the onboarding form and a simple banking template. If it helps we can schedule a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the form.

Hi GreenLeaf team — thanks for sending the banking template. Confirming Redwood's standard policy:

- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date by default. We can agree Net 45 in writing if needed.
- We accept ACH for recurring payments. For first-time ACH we can do micro-deposits verification; we do not require a voided check but it accelerates the process.
- Wires are accepted; Redwood does not automatically absorb incoming wire fees unless there's a prior agreement.
- PO requirement: For services over $5,000 we require a PO number before AP processes payment. For initial onboarding/one-off hardware purchases we can create an exception — Vanessa, please advise if you want to raise an exception for the initial parts order.

Next steps for GreenLeaf:
1) Complete and return Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (sign electronically via the DocuSign link below).
2) Fill and return banking_details_template.csv with both ACH and wire fields.
